gloss: waste paper; used paper; recycled paper
notes:
A compound of {古|こ} (old, used) and {紙|し} (paper). Common in environmental and recycling contexts. In Japan, waste paper collection is an important part of the detailed garbage separation system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古紙|こし}{回収|かいしゅう}: waste paper collection
- {古紙|こし}リサイクル: paper recycling
- {古紙|こし}{配合率|はいごうりつ}: recycled paper content ratio
- {古紙|こし}100パーセント: 100% recycled paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {再生紙|さいせいし}: recycled paper — emphasizes that the paper has been reprocessed
- {廃紙|はいし}: waste paper — more formal, emphasizes discarding

definitions.gloss: waste paper; used paper; recycled paper
definitions.explanation: paper that has been used and is collected for recycling; waste paper

examples.japanese: {古紙|こし}を{回収|かいしゅう}する。
{古紙|こし}はリサイクルに{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please put waste paper out for recycling.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{古紙|こし}100パーセントで{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This product is made from 100% recycled paper.
